## About
Preferred Insulation is an insulation contractor based on Maryland Ave in League City. We work on residential and commercial properties, with spray foam, attic, fiberglass and blown-in insulation.
The Gulf Coast is hot and humid, and the right insulation helps a building stay comfortable and use less energy. Along with League City, we serve Galveston, Texas City, Hitchcock, La Marque, Santa Fe, Alvin and Pearland.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 39 Google reviews. If rooms in your home keep swinging between warm and cool, give us a call or send us the details of your job.

## Services
- Spray foam insulation: A strong choice for energy efficiency in both homes and commercial buildings.
- Attic insulation: Helps your home hold up against pests, rodents, pollutants and high energy costs.
- Fiberglass insulation: A budget-friendly option with strong resistance to heat, popular with homeowners.
- Blown-in insulation: Fills cracks, gaps and openings throughout the house.
- Residential insulation: Makes your home more comfortable and more energy efficient.
- Commercial insulation: Insulation for business properties to help create a safer, healthier place to work.

## FAQ
Q: How do I know if I need insulation?
A: Watch for temperatures that keep shifting inside even when the weather outside is pleasant. You can also do a touch test: if your walls and paneling feel cold, your home likely needs more insulation.

Q: What is R-value and why does it matter?
A: R-value is a measure of how well insulation resists heat coming through your walls. The higher the R-value, the better the material keeps your home comfortable in intense heat.

Q: Do you offer free quotes?
A: Yes. Fill out the quote form with a few details about your job, or give us a call.
